description: Machine-readable fixture for the embedded execution stability policy: container isolation (E1), config domain sanitization (E2), workspace hygiene (E3), session store guard (E4), and post-completion fail-closed checks (E5).

v0Freeze.note: Embedded execution stability gates, container isolation invariants, config domain sanitization requirements, workspace hygiene deny patterns, session store guard preconditions, and post-completion fail-closed checks are frozen as the Contract v0 embedded execution stability baseline.

processIsolation.passCondition: the embedded agent process runs as PID 1 inside the container namespace
processIsolation.failClosedCondition: agent runs as a child of a process outside the container

processIsolation.passCondition: execution uses docker run --rm or podman run --rm; no host-side agent launch
processIsolation.failClosedCondition: agent is launched via a direct host exec path

processIsolation.passCondition: only authentication/config files are copied into the container; no entire workspace trees
processIsolation.failClosedCondition: broad cp -a of the full ~/.openclaw tree without per-file scoping

filesystemIsolation.passCondition: all host paths mounted into the container are declared via explicit extraMounts or runner-internal mount construction
filesystemIsolation.failClosedCondition: implicit host path access via bind propagation or unix socket sharing

filesystemIsolation.passCondition: the mounted host OpenClaw config directory is mounted :ro
filesystemIsolation.failClosedCondition: config directory is writable inside the container

filesystemIsolation.passCondition: the container workdir (/work) is the checked-out repository, not the host workspace
filesystemIsolation.failClosedCondition: workdir points to the host ~/.openclaw/workspace or a non-repo path

networkIsolation.passCondition: network mode defaults to bridge; host mode requires explicit PATCH_COMMAND_PROFILE=openclaw
networkIsolation.failClosedCondition: default configuration permits host-network access without documented profile override

networkIsolation.passCondition: embedded agent is configured with no live Telegram, Signal, or provider notification channel
networkIsolation.failClosedCondition: agent config contains live channel wiring or provider targets that could trigger sends

networkIsolation.passCondition: the agent's only external API calls are to the model provider for the current task
networkIsolation.failClosedCondition: agent performs unprompted external API calls not scoped to the current task

stripHostGatewayPluginChannelCron.passCondition: plugins, channels, gateway, cron, bindings, hooks are deleted from the config before agent start
stripHostGatewayPluginChannelCron.failClosedCondition: any of these sections remains in the sanitized config

keepOnlyOpenaiCodexProvider.passCondition: model providers are pruned to openai-codex only; all other providers removed
keepOnlyOpenaiCodexProvider.failClosedCondition: a non-openai-codex provider remains that could route to a different API

removeHeartbeatDefaults.passCondition: agents.defaults.heartbeat and per-agent heartbeat are deleted
removeHeartbeatDefaults.failClosedCondition: heartbeat configuration could trigger unprompted periodic work

removeAgentRuntimeFallback.passCondition: agents.defaults.agentRuntime.fallback and per-agent runtime fallback are deleted
removeAgentRuntimeFallback.failClosedCondition: fallback model could trigger unprompted API calls

clearModelFallbacks.passCondition: model.fallbacks is set to an empty array
clearModelFallbacks.failClosedCondition: fallback model list could trigger unprompted retries

onlyAuthFilesCopied.passCondition: only openclaw.json, node.json, credentials/*, auth-profiles.json, auth-state.json, models.json are copied from the host config
onlyAuthFilesCopied.failClosedCondition: worker workspace, caches, plugin runtimes, archives, or session logs are copied

ghTokenIsEphemeralTaskToken.passCondition: only the ephemeral GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN set by the task payload is injected; no permanent host token
ghTokenIsEphemeralTaskToken.failClosedCondition: a permanent host token from the host config is used instead of the task-scoped token

tokenLivesOnlyInContainerMemory.passCondition: the injected token exists only in the disposable container's config file and is never written to artifacts
tokenLivesOnlyInContainerMemory.failClosedCondition: token appears in summary.txt, patch-command.log, or any artifact file

workspaceAlignment.passCondition: OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR is set to $PWD (the repository checkout root)
workspaceAlignment.failClosedCondition: OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE_DIR points to the host agent workspace or is unset

workspaceAlignment.passCondition: the disposable in-container openclaw.json has agents.defaults.workspace and active agent workspace set to checkout path
workspaceAlignment.failClosedCondition: config workspace entry is missing, stale, or points to a non-checkout path

workspaceAlignment.passCondition: the runner never deletes or recreates ~/.openclaw/workspace as a sandbox alignment mechanism
workspaceAlignment.failClosedCondition: runner deletes or recreates the host workspace path

preExecutionHygiene.passCondition: before agent start, the in-container config is verified to point workspace at the checkout
preExecutionHygiene.failClosedCondition: config workspace entry does not point to the checkout path

preExecutionHygiene.check: host workspace path is not swept
preExecutionHygiene.passCondition: before agent start, the summary records openclaw_workspace=$PWD
preExecutionHygiene.failClosedCondition: workspace path in summary is a host path or the default agent workspace

postExecutionHygiene.passCondition: after agent completion, git status --porcelain is checked for any deny path files; if found, exits 4 with error
postExecutionHygiene.failClosedCondition: deny path files are present and the runner does not detect them

postExecutionHygiene.passCondition: if bootstrap leaks are detected, each leak path is recorded in summary.txt with bootstrap_leak= prefix
postExecutionHygiene.failClosedCondition: leaks are detected but not recorded in summary evidence

readOnlyMountEnforcement.passCondition: the extraMount for the OpenClaw config directory has readOnly: true
the container never writes to the mounted config directory
readOnlyMountEnforcement.failClosedCondition: container writes to any path under the mounted config directory

readOnlyMountEnforcement.passCondition: the session store guard is evaluated before the agent starts
readOnlyMountEnforcement.failClosedCondition: agent starts without session store guard evaluation

emptySessionDetection.passCondition: the sessions registry for the active agent must have entries
emptySessionDetection.failClosedCondition: active-agent sessions registry is empty -- execution is blocked

emptySessionDetection.passCondition: empty session registries for non-active agents produce a warning, not a block
emptySessionDetection.failClosedCondition: empty non-active-agent session registries silently ignored or block execution

emptySessionDetection.passCondition: empty non-active-agent registries are recorded in summary.txt with warning= prefix
emptySessionDetection.failClosedCondition: warnings are suppressed and not recorded

invariants.failClosedCondition: backup count at or above threshold produces a warning

invariants.passCondition: total backup file bytes below documented threshold (default: 128 MB)
invariants.failClosedCondition: backup bytes at or above threshold produces a warning

invariants.passCondition: buildup warnings include count=, bytes= and recorded in summary.txt with warning= prefix

failureModes.description: bootstrap or persona file detected in checkout after agent completion
failureModes.failClosedCondition: any deny path present in checkout after agent completion

failureModes.description: agent produced no repository changes; false Done refused
failureModes.failClosedCondition: agent completed but checkout has no file changes

failureModes.description: OpenClaw config directory not mounted or empty
failureModes.failClosedCondition: openclaw.json is absent inside the mounted config dir
